```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  message    = FALSE,
  fig.align  = "center",
  fig.crop   = FALSE,  # legacy pdfcrop option
  crop       = FALSE   # disables knitr's magick-based PNG cropping
)

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(gamlss)

fit          <- params$fit
suite        <- params$suite
scored       <- params$scored
training     <- fit$training_data
scale_params <- fit$scale_params
predictors   <- fit$predictors
has_scored   <- !is.null(scored)
has_suite    <- !is.null(suite) && length(suite) > 1

invisible(stopifnot(inherits(fit, "calmer_fit")))
```

# Predictors

CALMeR conditions MAPQ on the following per-read / per-transcript
features. Default `clean_features()` filters are listed alongside;
ranges shown in the partial-effects plots may be tighter (e.g.
`n_isoforms` is capped at 7 in the partial-effect panel for visual
clarity).

| Predictor | What it measures | How it's computed | Default `clean_features()` filter |
|---|---|---|---|
| `n_isoforms` | Number of annotated isoforms of the **gene** that the read's target transcript belongs to. | `n_distinct(transcript_id)` per `gene_id`, from the GTF. | `<= 10` |
| `tx_length` | Length of the target transcript in nucleotides. | Sum of exon widths per `transcript_id`, from the GTF. | `[100, 10000]` bp |
| `gc_content` | GC composition of the target transcript. | `(G + C) / length` from the transcriptome FASTA. | `[30, 70]%` |
| `pct_covered` | Fraction of the target transcript spanned by the read alignment. | `min(alignment_length / tx_length, 1)`, from the BAM CIGAR + GTF. | none (uses full 0-100% range) |
| `max_pct_id` *(if present)* | Highest cross-gene transcript-level identity for the target. Captures paralog ambiguity. | `minimap2` self-alignment of the transcriptome FASTA, then `max(pct_id)` over hits with `alen >= 50` and `query_cov >= 70%`, restricted to cross-gene pairs. | none (raw 0-100%; 0 = no paralog) |

The partial-effects plot caps `n_isoforms` at **7** for the x-axis even
when training data extends higher, since most of the predictive content
sits in the 1-7 range and very high values become sparse.

# 1. Training summary

The model was fit on `r nrow(training)` reads sampled from primary
alignments. Predictors used: `r paste(predictors, collapse = ", ")`.

```{r training_predictor_ranges}
ranges <- lapply(predictors, function(p) {
  v <- training[[p]]
  data.frame(predictor = p,
             min       = min(v, na.rm = TRUE),
             median    = median(v, na.rm = TRUE),
             max       = max(v, na.rm = TRUE),
             sd        = sd(v, na.rm = TRUE))
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

knitr::kable(ranges, digits = 2, caption = "Predictor distributions on the training data.")
```

```{r mapq_dist, fig.height = 3.5, fig.cap = "Observed MAPQ distribution on training data."}
ggplot(training, aes(x = MAPQ)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)) +
  labs(x = "MAPQ", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 2. Model fit

```{r model_summary, results = "asis"}
cat("**Formulas used:**\n\n")
cat("- $\\mu$:    `",    deparse1(fit$formula$mu),    "`\n", sep = "")
cat("- $\\sigma$: `", deparse1(fit$formula$sigma), "`\n", sep = "")
cat("- $\\nu$:    `",    deparse1(fit$formula$nu),    "`\n", sep = "")
cat("- $\\tau$:   `",   deparse1(fit$formula$tau),   "`\n", sep = "")
```

```{r edf_table}
extract_edfs <- function(model, what) {
  smos <- tryCatch(
    lapply(seq_len(20), function(i) {
      x <- try(getSmo(model, what = what, which = i), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(x, "try-error")) NULL else x
    }),
    error = function(e) list()
  )
  smos <- Filter(Negate(is.null), smos)
  if (length(smos) == 0L) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    parameter = what,
    term      = vapply(smos, function(x) if (!is.null(x$name)) x$name else NA_character_, character(1)),
    edf       = vapply(smos, function(x) if (!is.null(x$edf))  x$edf  else NA_real_,      numeric(1))
  )
}

edf_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "mu"),
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "sigma"),
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "nu"),
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "tau")
)

if (!is.null(edf_df) && nrow(edf_df) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(edf_df, digits = 2,
               caption = "Effective degrees of freedom for each smooth term.")
}
```

```{r rsq, results = "asis"}
rsq <- tryCatch(round(gamlss::Rsq(fit$fit), 4), error = function(e) NA_real_)
cat("**Pseudo-$R^2$:** ", rsq, "\n", sep = "")
```

# 2b. Model comparison

```{asis, echo = has_suite}
A suite of BEINF fits is summarised below. The suite includes the four
canonical defaults — `pb` smoothers on the canonical predictors with
and without a paralog term, plus the corresponding linear-term
variants — and optionally a user-supplied fit. AIC, BIC, training EDF
and gamlss's pseudo-$R^2$ appear in the table; side-by-side QQ panels
follow. **The primary fit (used downstream by `score_reads()` and the
sections below) is highlighted.**
```

```{asis, echo = !has_suite}
Refits on the same training data with two alternative
parameterizations: **(i)** linear terms in $\mu$, $\nu$, $\tau$ (this
is what the user supplied if no spline override was given), and
**(ii)** penalized B-splines with five interior knots in all three.
$\sigma$ is held to an intercept-only formula in both. AIC, BIC, and
gamlss's pseudo-$R^2$ are reported alongside the user-supplied fit.
For a richer comparison, fit a suite of models with
`fit_beinf_suite()` and pass it to `calmer_report()`.
```

```{r model_comparison_fit, results = "hide"}
extract_metrics <- function(m, label, is_primary = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(m)) {
    return(data.frame(Model = label, AIC = NA, BIC = NA,
                      df = NA, `Pseudo R^2` = NA,
                      check.names = FALSE))
  }
  rsq <- tryCatch(gamlss::Rsq(m), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  data.frame(
    Model        = if (is_primary) paste0(label, " (primary)") else label,
    AIC          = round(AIC(m), 1),
    BIC          = round(BIC(m), 1),
    df           = round(m$df.fit, 1),
    `Pseudo R^2` = round(rsq, 4),
    check.names  = FALSE
  )
}

if (has_suite) {
  primary_name <- attr(suite, "primary")
  cmp_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(suite), function(nm) {
    extract_metrics(suite[[nm]]$fit, nm, is_primary = (nm == primary_name))
  }))
  qq_fits <- suite
} else {
  training    <- fit$training_data
  all_preds   <- fit$predictors
  non_paralog <- setdiff(all_preds, "max_pct_id")
  preds_all_sc <- paste0(all_preds,   "_sc")
  preds_np_sc  <- paste0(non_paralog, "_sc")

  lin_all_rhs <- paste(preds_all_sc, collapse = " + ")
  lin_np_rhs  <- paste(preds_np_sc,  collapse = " + ")
  pb_terms_np <- paste0("pb(", preds_np_sc, ", inter = 5)", collapse = " + ")
  pb_mix_rhs  <- if ("max_pct_id" %in% all_preds) {
    paste(pb_terms_np, "+ max_pct_id_sc")
  } else {
    pb_terms_np
  }

  fit_silent <- function(mu_rhs, nu_rhs, tau_rhs) {
    tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(gamlss::gamlss(
        formula       = stats::as.formula(paste("y ~", mu_rhs)),
        sigma.formula = ~ 1,
        nu.formula    = stats::as.formula(paste("~", nu_rhs)),
        tau.formula   = stats::as.formula(paste("~", tau_rhs)),
        family        = gamlss.dist::BEINF(),
        data          = training,
        control       = gamlss::gamlss.control(trace = FALSE)
      )),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }

  mod_lin_all <- fit_silent(lin_all_rhs, lin_all_rhs, lin_all_rhs)
  mod_lin_np  <- fit_silent(lin_np_rhs,  lin_np_rhs,  lin_np_rhs)
  mod_pb_mix  <- fit_silent(pb_mix_rhs,  pb_mix_rhs,  pb_mix_rhs)

  cmp_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    extract_metrics(fit$fit,     "user-supplied (primary)", is_primary = TRUE),
    extract_metrics(mod_lin_all, "linear (all predictors)"),
    extract_metrics(mod_lin_np,  "linear (no max_pct_id)"),
    extract_metrics(mod_pb_mix,  "pb on 4 + linear max_pct_id")
  )
  qq_fits <- NULL
}
```

```{r model_comparison_table}
knitr::kable(cmp_tbl,
             caption = "Model fit metrics on the training data. Lower AIC/BIC and higher pseudo-$R^2$ are better.")
```

```{r model_comparison_qq, eval = has_suite, fig.height = 3 * ceiling(length(suite) / 2), fig.cap = "Standard-normal QQ plot of randomized quantile residuals on the training set, one panel per suite fit."}
qq_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(qq_fits), function(nm) {
  f       <- qq_fits[[nm]]
  rqr_in  <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(qnorm(stats::residuals(f$fit, type = "quantile"))),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(f$training_data))
  )
  data.frame(model = nm, rqr = rqr_in)
})) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rqr))

if (nrow(qq_df) > 0L) {
  ggplot(qq_df, aes(sample = rqr)) +
    stat_qq(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5, colour = "steelblue") +
    stat_qq_line(colour = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Theoretical N(0, 1) quantile",
         y = "Randomized quantile residual") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
}
```

# 3. Residual diagnostics

Randomized quantile residuals (RQR) should be approximately $N(0, 1)$
under a correctly specified BEINF model.

```{r residuals_compute}
qr_train <- stats::residuals(fit$fit)
qr_df <- data.frame(qr = qr_train, n_isoforms = training$n_isoforms)
```

```{r qq_density, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Global QQ plot (left) and density vs N(0, 1) (right)."}
qq_pts <- stats::qqnorm(qr_train, plot.it = FALSE)
qq_df <- data.frame(theoretical = qq_pts$x, sample = qq_pts$y)

p_qq <- ggplot(qq_df, aes(x = theoretical, y = sample)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "RQR") +
  theme_minimal()

p_dens <- ggplot(data.frame(qr = qr_train), aes(x = qr)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "RQR", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

p_qq + p_dens
```

```{r resid_by_predictor, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "RQR density faceted by predictor bins, with N(0, 1) reference (red dashed)."}
make_rqr_facet <- function(predictor_name, n_bins = 5) {
  values <- training[[predictor_name]]
  if (length(unique(values)) <= 10) {
    bin   <- factor(values)
    label <- predictor_name
  } else {
    qs    <- stats::quantile(values, seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1),
                             na.rm = TRUE)
    bin   <- cut(values, breaks = unique(qs), include.lowest = TRUE,
                 dig.lab = 4)
    label <- paste0(predictor_name, " (quantile bin)")
  }
  qr_df <- data.frame(qr = qr_train, bin = bin) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$bin))
  ggplot(qr_df, aes(x = qr)) +
    geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, color = "red", linetype = "dashed",
                  linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ bin, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "RQR", y = "Density", title = label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
}

for (p in predictors) {
  print(make_rqr_facet(p))
}
```

# 4. Partial effects on E[MAPQ]

Each panel varies one predictor over its training range while holding
the others at their training median, and shows the model's expected
MAPQ:

$$
E[Y] \;=\; \frac{\tau + \mu}{1 + \nu + \tau}, \qquad
E[\mathrm{MAPQ}] = 60 \cdot E[Y]
$$

```{r partial_effects_ey, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Partial effects on E[MAPQ]."}
n_grid <- 200
make_base_nd <- function(n) {
  base <- as.data.frame(lapply(predictors, function(p) {
    rep(stats::median(training[[paste0(p, "_sc")]], na.rm = TRUE), n)
  }))
  names(base) <- paste0(predictors, "_sc")
  for (p in predictors) {
    base[[p]] <- rep(stats::median(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE), n)
  }
  base$y <- rep(stats::median(training$y, na.rm = TRUE), n)
  base
}

predict_ey <- function(nd) {
  mu_p  <- stats::predict(fit$fit, newdata = nd, what = "mu",
                          type = "response", data = training)
  nu_p  <- stats::predict(fit$fit, newdata = nd, what = "nu",
                          type = "response", data = training)
  tau_p <- stats::predict(fit$fit, newdata = nd, what = "tau",
                          type = "response", data = training)
  (tau_p + mu_p) / (1 + nu_p + tau_p) * 60
}

ey_panels <- lapply(predictors, function(p) {
  nd     <- make_base_nd(n_grid)
  x_lo   <- min(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
  x_hi   <- max(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (p == "n_isoforms") x_hi <- min(x_hi, 7)   # cap n_isoforms at 7
  raw_seq <- seq(x_lo, x_hi, length.out = n_grid)
  nd[[paste0(p, "_sc")]] <- (raw_seq - scale_params[[p]]$center) /
                            scale_params[[p]]$scale
  nd[[p]] <- raw_seq
  df <- data.frame(x = raw_seq, y = predict_ey(nd))
  log_x <- p == "tx_length"
  p_obj <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.9) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 60)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)) +
    labs(x = p, y = "E[MAPQ]", title = p) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
  if (log_x) p_obj <- p_obj + scale_x_log10()
  p_obj
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(ey_panels, nrow = 1)
```

```{r scoring_setup, eval = has_scored, include = FALSE}
flag_thresh   <- attr(scored, "flag_threshold")
filt_method   <- attr(scored, "filter_method")
threshold     <- attr(scored, "threshold")
dev_threshold <- attr(scored, "dev_threshold")
p0_threshold  <- attr(scored, "p0_threshold")
n_total       <- nrow(scored)
n_scored      <- sum(!is.na(scored$rqr))
n_flagged     <- sum(scored$flag_low %in% TRUE)
flag_src      <- if ("flag_source" %in% names(scored)) {
                   scored$flag_source
                 } else {
                   rep(NA_character_, nrow(scored))
                 }
n_flag_rqr    <- sum(flag_src == "rqr_low",     na.rm = TRUE)
n_flag_p0     <- sum(flag_src == "p0_dev_high", na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r scoring_header, eval = has_scored, results = "asis"}
cat("# 5. Scoring summary\n\n")
cat("Flagging is asymmetric across the MAPQ range:\n\n")
cat("- **MAPQ in (0, 60)**: RQR low-tail rule.\n")
cat("- **MAPQ = 0**: binomial deviance rule on the predicted zero-mass probability.\n")
cat("- **MAPQ = 60**: never flagged (max MAPQ cannot be 'unusually low').\n\n")
cat(sprintf("- Filter method:           **%s**\n", filt_method))
cat(sprintf("- RQR threshold:           **%g** (flag if RQR < %.3f)\n",
            threshold, flag_thresh))
if (!is.null(dev_threshold) && !is.null(p0_threshold)) {
  cat(sprintf("- MAPQ = 0 deviance cut:   sqrt(-2 log p_hat_0) > %.2f  (p_hat_0 < %.4g)\n",
              dev_threshold, p0_threshold))
}
cat(sprintf("- Reads scored:            %d / %d\n", n_scored, n_total))
cat(sprintf("- Reads flagged:           %d (%.2f%% of scored)\n",
            n_flagged, 100 * n_flagged / max(n_scored, 1)))
if ("flag_source" %in% names(scored)) {
  cat(sprintf("  - via RQR low-tail:       %d (%.2f%% of scored)\n",
              n_flag_rqr, 100 * n_flag_rqr / max(n_scored, 1)))
  cat(sprintf("  - via MAPQ = 0 deviance:  %d (%.2f%% of scored)\n",
              n_flag_p0,  100 * n_flag_p0  / max(n_scored, 1)))
}
```

```{r flags_by_niso_table, eval = has_scored}
has_src <- "flag_source" %in% names(scored)
flag_by_niso <- scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$rqr)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$n_isoforms) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_scored          = dplyr::n(),
    n_flagged         = sum(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE),
    pct_flagged       = round(100 * mean(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE), 2),
    n_flag_rqr        = if (has_src)
                          sum(.data$flag_source == "rqr_low") else NA_integer_,
    n_flag_p0         = if (has_src)
                          sum(.data$flag_source == "p0_dev_high") else NA_integer_,
    median_tx_length  = round(stats::median(.data$tx_length, na.rm = TRUE)),
    median_gc_content = round(stats::median(.data$gc_content, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_paralog_gt50  = if ("max_pct_id" %in% names(scored))
                          round(100 * mean(.data$max_pct_id > 50, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
                        else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(.data$n_isoforms)

knitr::kable(flag_by_niso,
  caption = paste("Per n_isoforms: scored count, total flagged, % flagged,",
                  "flags from each rule (n_flag_rqr = RQR low-tail on",
                  "MAPQ in 1..59; n_flag_p0 = deviance rule on MAPQ = 0),",
                  "and group-level context (median tx_length, median",
                  "gc_content, % of reads on transcripts with a paralog",
                  "at >50% identity)."))
```

```{r flags_heatmap, eval = has_scored, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Flag rate (% of scored reads flagged) by n_isoforms x pct_covered bin. Cell labels show the absolute number of flagged reads in the bin."}
pct_breaks <- seq(0, 100, by = 10)
pct_labels <- paste0(pct_breaks[-length(pct_breaks)], "-", pct_breaks[-1], "%")

hm <- scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$rqr)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_cov_bin = cut(.data$pct_covered, breaks = pct_breaks,
                      include.lowest = TRUE, labels = pct_labels)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$pct_cov_bin)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$n_isoforms, .data$pct_cov_bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_scored   = dplyr::n(),
                   n_flagged  = sum(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE),
                   .groups    = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct_flagged = 100 * n_flagged / pmax(n_scored, 1))

ggplot(hm, aes(x = factor(n_isoforms), y = pct_cov_bin, fill = pct_flagged)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n_flagged >= 1,
                               format(n_flagged, big.mark = ","), "")),
            size = 2.4, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "#D85A30",
                      name = "% flagged",
                      labels = function(v) sprintf("%.2f%%", v)) +
  labs(x = "n_isoforms", y = "pct_covered bin",
       subtitle = "Fill = flag rate per cell; labels = absolute flagged-read count.") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

```{r mapq_by_flag, eval = has_scored, fig.height = 3.5, fig.cap = "Scored MAPQ distribution. Rug ticks mark flagged reads, coloured by flag source: orange = RQR low-tail (MAPQ in 1..59), purple = MAPQ = 0 deviance (model predicted zero-mass to be unlikely)."}
scored_ok <- scored |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$rqr))
flagged   <- scored_ok |> dplyr::filter(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE)

# Backwards-compat: older scored frames may not carry flag_source.
if (!"flag_source" %in% names(flagged)) {
  flagged$flag_source <- "rqr_low"
}
flagged$flag_source <- factor(flagged$flag_source,
                              levels = c("rqr_low", "p0_dev_high"))

ggplot(scored_ok, aes(x = MAPQ)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue",
                 color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_rug(data = flagged, aes(x = MAPQ, colour = flag_source),
           inherit.aes = FALSE,
           linewidth = 0.8, length = unit(0.04, "npc"),
           alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(rqr_low     = "#D85A30",
               p0_dev_high = "#7B3294"),
    labels = c(rqr_low     = "RQR low-tail (1..59)",
               p0_dev_high = "MAPQ = 0 deviance"),
    name   = "Flag source",
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "MAPQ", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r flag_strat_setup, eval = has_scored, include = FALSE}
has_paralog <- "max_pct_id" %in% names(scored)

scored_pred <- scored |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$rqr))

make_bins <- function(x, breaks, labels) {
  cut(x, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = labels, right = FALSE)
}

gc_breaks <- c(30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70)
gc_labels <- c("30-35", "35-40", "40-45", "45-50",
               "50-55", "55-60", "60-65", "65-70")
scored_pred$gc_bin <- make_bins(scored_pred$gc_content, gc_breaks, gc_labels)

tx_breaks <- c(0, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, Inf)
tx_labels <- c("<250", "250-500", "500-1k", "1k-2k", ">=2k")
scored_pred$tx_bin <- make_bins(scored_pred$tx_length, tx_breaks, tx_labels)

if (has_paralog) {
  # max_pct_id == 0 exactly for non-paralogs, so split on (0, 50), etc.
  pp_breaks <- c(-Inf, 0.5, 50, 80, 90, 100.5)
  pp_labels <- c("None (0)", "(0,50)", "[50,80)", "[80,90)", ">=90")
  scored_pred$pp_bin <- make_bins(scored_pred$max_pct_id,
                                  pp_breaks, pp_labels)
}

summarise_bin <- function(df, bin_col) {
  df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[bin_col]])) |>
    dplyr::group_by(bin = .data[[bin_col]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_scored   = dplyr::n(),
      n_flag_rqr = sum(.data$flag_source == "rqr_low",     na.rm = TRUE),
      n_flag_p0  = sum(.data$flag_source == "p0_dev_high", na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pct_rqr = 100 * .data$n_flag_rqr / pmax(.data$n_scored, 1),
      pct_p0  = 100 * .data$n_flag_p0  / pmax(.data$n_scored, 1)
    )
}

plot_bin_rates <- function(tab, xlab) {
  long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    tab |> dplyr::transmute(.data$bin, .data$n_scored,
                            src = "MAPQ = 0 deviance",
                            pct = .data$pct_p0),
    tab |> dplyr::transmute(.data$bin, .data$n_scored,
                            src = "RQR low-tail (1..59)",
                            pct = .data$pct_rqr)
  )
  long$src <- factor(long$src,
                     levels = c("MAPQ = 0 deviance",
                                "RQR low-tail (1..59)"))
  totals <- tab |>
    dplyr::mutate(pct_total = .data$pct_rqr + .data$pct_p0)
  ggplot(long, aes(x = .data$bin, y = .data$pct, fill = .data$src)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    geom_text(data = totals,
              aes(x = .data$bin, y = .data$pct_total,
                  label = format(.data$n_scored, big.mark = ",")),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              vjust = -0.4, size = 2.4, color = "grey30") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("MAPQ = 0 deviance"   = "#7B3294",
                                 "RQR low-tail (1..59)" = "#D85A30"),
                      name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18)),
                       labels = function(v) sprintf("%.2f%%", v)) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "% flagged") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r flags_by_predictor, eval = has_scored, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.2, fig.cap = "Flag rate per bin of each transcript-level predictor, stratified by flag source. Bars are stacked (purple = MAPQ = 0 deviance, orange = RQR low-tail in MAPQ in 1..59); numbers above each bar are total reads scored in that bin. The gc_content panel uses 5% bins across the clean_features() clamp range; tx_length uses log-spaced bins; max_pct_id separates non-paralog transcripts (= 0) from the four paralog identity bands."}
p_gc <- plot_bin_rates(summarise_bin(scored_pred, "gc_bin"),
                       "gc_content (%)")
p_tx <- plot_bin_rates(summarise_bin(scored_pred, "tx_bin"),
                       "tx_length (bp)")

panels <- if (has_paralog) {
  p_pp <- plot_bin_rates(summarise_bin(scored_pred, "pp_bin"),
                         "max_pct_id (%)")
  p_gc + p_tx + p_pp
} else {
  p_gc + p_tx
}

panels +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r paralog_ecdf, eval = has_scored && has_paralog, fig.height = 3.8, fig.cap = "Empirical CDF of max_pct_id across scored reads, split by flag status. If flagged reads are paralog-enriched, the orange (flagged) curve sits to the right of the grey (unflagged) curve at intermediate-to-high identity values."}
ecdf_df <- scored_pred |>
  dplyr::mutate(flagged = ifelse(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE,
                                 "Flagged", "Unflagged"))
ggplot(ecdf_df, aes(x = .data$max_pct_id, colour = .data$flagged)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "step", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Flagged   = "#D85A30",
                                 Unflagged = "grey40"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 90, 100)) +
  labs(x = "max_pct_id (cross-gene paralog identity, %)",
       y = "ECDF") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r paralog_within_mapq0, eval = has_scored && has_paralog}
enrich <- scored_pred |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$MAPQ == 0) |>
  dplyr::mutate(flagged = ifelse(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE,
                                 "Flagged (p0 dev > threshold)",
                                 "Unflagged")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$flagged) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_reads          = dplyr::n(),
    n_paralog_ge50   = sum(.data$max_pct_id >= 50, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_paralog_ge50 = round(100 * mean(.data$max_pct_id >= 50,
                                        na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    n_paralog_ge90   = sum(.data$max_pct_id >= 90, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_paralog_ge90 = round(100 * mean(.data$max_pct_id >= 90,
                                        na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups          = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(enrich,
  caption = paste("Paralog enrichment within MAPQ = 0 reads.",
                  "Compares the deviance-flagged subset against the",
                  "unflagged MAPQ = 0 background on the fraction of",
                  "reads whose target transcript has a cross-gene",
                  "paralog at >=50% / >=90% identity. A higher rate",
                  "in the flagged row indicates that the deviance",
                  "rule is preferentially flagging paralog-ambiguous",
                  "reads."))
```
